responseMessageContents.text:
The error message came directly from Apple's response when Rork tried to sign in to your Apple ID to submit the build. Specifically, Apple returned:

- HTTP status `403`
- Service error code `-20209`
- Message: *"This Apple Account has been locked for security reasons. Visit iForgot to reset your account."*

That's Apple's own lock notice — not something Rork inferred. You can see it in the error log you pasted (the `appleAuth` block). Once you unlock it via iforgot.apple.com, retry the submission and it should proceed.
